title: Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)
learning_objectives: Integrate security into each SDLC phase
Use SAST and DAST in CI/CD pipelines

post_assessment.question: What does shift-left mean in secure software development?
options: Move security testing to earlier phases
Move security teams to the left side
post_assessment.explanation: Shift-left means moving security testing earlier in the development lifecycle. Instead of finding vulnerabilities in production catch them during design and coding. This is 10-100x less expensive and more effective.

content.text: Welcome to Secure SDLC! Fixing security bugs costs 100x more in production than during design. Most vulnerabilities are introduced during development yet testing happens at the end. SSDLC integrates security throughout preventing vulnerabilities before production!
